question: If the length, breadth and height of a cuboid are 16 cm, 15 cm and 12 cm respectively, then the length of the longest diagonal of the cuboid is _______.
solution:
Given:

The length of the cuboid = 12 cm

The breadth of the cuboid = 9 cm

The height of the cuboid = 8 cm

Formula used:

D = √(l² + b² + h²)

where, D = The longest diagonal of a cuboid, l = The length of a cuboid

b = The breadth of a cuboid, h = The height of a cuboid

Calculation:

According to the question, 

D = √(162 +152 + 122)

⇒ √(256 +225 + 144)

⇒ √625

⇒ 25 cm

∴ The longest diagonal of the cuboid is 25 cm.
